messages:
maria: Quick FYI — planning to roll v2.3.1 (routing + perf fixes) to prod at 11:00 PT today. Expect ~15m for rollout. Need smoke owners and rollback confirmation.

aj: I can own smoke checks. I'll run the smoke script and monitor latency dashboards at +5m.

sophie: I'll be on model/fallback watch and run quick prompt regressions after canary.

tom-ops: I'll lead the deploy. Plan: canary -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% over ~10m. Rollback artifact: build-20260312-487 (image tag `r2.3.1-487`). I'll paste a minimal rollback snippet below.

deploy-bot: Deploy window reserved 11:00-11:30 PT for team eng-releases. Ticket DL-4521 created.

maria: Short deploy checklist: 
- [x] Release notes posted (docs/release/v2.3.1)
- [x] No DB migrations
- [ ] Smoke owners ack
- [ ] Rollback verified by ops

aj: ack — smoke owner. Running: `/opt/scripts/smoke.sh --env prod --subset web` at 11:05. Will post results.

kevin: Security scans green on the build I checked. :thumbsup:

sophie: ack — will run 10 quick prompt checks post-canary.

tom-ops: Rollback runbook snippet (keeps it quick):
```
# rollback quick
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/inference inference=redwood/inference:r2.3.1-487
kubectl rollout status deploy/inference -n prod
# verify via /health and a quick curl against v2 endpoint
```

maria: If smoke fails we rollback immediately and open an incident. If smoke passes, proceed to 100% with 10m ramp.

aj: smoke run complete @ 11:07 — endpoints returned 200, p50 ~72ms, no ERROR-level logs. Result: PASS.

sophie: prompt regression: 10/10 good, small wording variance on prompt #7 but no functional regression.

tom-ops: Canary -> 20% at 11:12. Metrics stable. Increasing to 50% now.

kevin: Re-running an automated sec check after canary, still clean.

maria: Good to continue to 100% from my side. Thanks all. :tada:

tom-ops: Rolled to 100% at 11:20. Monitoring window open for 10m then extended to 1h for the team. Closing DL-4521 after monitors look OK.

deploy-bot: Deployment DL-4521 completed by tom-ops at 11:20 PT. Links: logs (restricted), metrics dashboard (internal).

aj: I'll shadow alerts for +1h and report anything unusual here.

sophie: I'll run the scheduled eval in 30m and post results.

maria: Nice work — if any follow-ups open a PR or ping this thread.
